acceptanceCriteria: A spec section (amending docs/specs/change-compiled-e2e-v0.md or a new spec) states the prover's intent, numbered requirements, non-goals, failure modes and rollback, with the owner's kill/pivot decision of 2026-10-18 as authority.

`corvint-test e2e prove` (or its successor) runs an existing hosted Playwright test, selected by name or file, at base and head with the test tree held at head, and reports the CCE-V0-009/016..018 verdict ladder without compiling anything.
A behaviour-removal control (omitted-event, V1-1679) kills the F1 static-overlay falsifier, and a no-op diff does not score as useful (V1-1713).
A rerun on actualbudget/actual's 4 fixes that shipped hosted e2e tests (3234be04d, c65884a27, eb28966d6, bc9bba67f) records per-change verdicts, minutes and usefulness in a build-log entry.
body: Owner decision 2026-10-18 after the V1-1677 spike (docs/build-log/2026-10-18-cce-spike-v1-1677.md): kill V0 compilation and pivot to a discrimination prover over hosted tests. The spike found 0/10 fixes useful, because the map, the impact hop and the oracle form each failed. 4/10 of those fixes shipped a hosted e2e test, and those tests use getByRole, toBeVisible and other forms that V0 cannot emit. The prover takes hosted tests as given and proves whether they discriminate the change, reusing the delivered prove machinery: BBF controls, the CCE-V0-021 environment block (V1-1681, beamfall/corvint#1091), and receipts. Its known holes from the falsifiers: F1 static text reads DISCRIMINATES (sha256:d6e205fb...), and F2 no-op reads PRESERVES (sha256:5647a092...).
